name: vlm_nuclear_cap_presence
description: Detects the presence of 'nuclear caps' (asymmetric clustering of organelles or nuclear envelope deformations), a phenotype linked to oxidative stress and specific drug mechanisms.
segmentation_prompt: Segment individual cells, focusing on the nuclear-cytoplasmic interface.
method_rationale: This feature describes a specific, asymmetric spatial configuration that is semantically distinct and easier to describe in natural language than to code geometrically.
